page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.xlarge is a compute-optimized instance configured with 4 dedicated virtual CPUs mapped to 2 physical Intel Xeon 8369B cores running at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. Operating on the x86_64 architecture under a KVM hypervisor, this instance features 8.0 GB of RAM, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio (2.0 GB per core). Hardware-level acceleration includes AVX-512 with VNNI, AES, VAES, and SHA_NI extensions, backed by a 48 MB L3 cache. The server includes a baseline network throughput of 5 Gbps and contains no local storage.

Performance benchmarks highlight average single-threaded CPU capability paired with lower relative multi-core throughput and memory bandwidth. The instance achieves a single-core stress-ng score of 1841.49 and a single-core Geekbench score of 1554.0. However, multi-core benchmarks rank lower, registering a Geekbench multi-core score of 3302.0 and an uncached memory read bandwidth of 30.43 GB/sec. Multi-threaded decompression performance falls in the lower performance brackets, demonstrating clear performance tradeoffs for workloads requiring high memory bandwidth or parallel computation across large thread pools.

Qualitatively, the resource configuration offers cost efficiency for applications that prioritize basic multi-vCPU capabilities and network baseline without requiring dedicated local disk infrastructure or large RAM footprints. The hardware architecture makes Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.xlarge suitable for web serving, single-threaded computational tasks, API gateways, and light HTTP application hosting.
